answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36757 Country: India Title: I have noticed in a nikah that took place in the local Masjid, that immediately after nikah is done Question: I have noticed in a nikah that took place in the local Masjid, that immediately after nikah is done people stand up and start hugging each other and congratulating each other and celebrate the fact nikah took place. Is there any basis of this in Islam? Is it permissible? Answer ID: 36757 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 294/L=192/TL=1433) It is not a Shariah practice to hug each other, congratulate or celebrate the nikah while standing just after nikah. As it is an expression of happiness, it does not carry any harm. However, it is against etiquette to celebrate such type of celebration in a Masjid; hence it should not be celebrated in the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
